question: How many repeat customers were there in January–June 2025 and in July–December 2025? Evaluate repeat status separately within each reporting period, then say which half had more.

action.query:
WITH customer_order_counts AS (
  SELECT CUSTOMER_ID,
         COUNT_IF(ORDER_DATE >= '2025-01-01' AND ORDER_DATE < '2025-07-01') AS JAN_JUN_ORDERS,
         COUNT_IF(ORDER_DATE >= '2025-07-01' AND ORDER_DATE < '2026-01-01') AS JUL_DEC_ORDERS
  FROM ZOMATO_DLR.CORE.FACT_ORDER
  WHERE ORDER_DATE >= '2025-01-01' AND ORDER_DATE < '2026-01-01'
    AND CUSTOMER_ID IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY CUSTOMER_ID
)
SELECT COUNT_IF(JAN_JUN_ORDERS >= 2) AS JAN_JUN_REPEAT_CUSTOMERS,
       COUNT_IF(JUL_DEC_ORDERS >= 2) AS JUL_DEC_REPEAT_CUSTOMERS
FROM customer_order_counts

action.answer: Using recorded ORDER_DATE and defining a repeat customer as a customer with at least 2 orders within the reporting half: January–June 2025 had 95,048 repeat customers; July–December 2025 had 96,514. These are counts of distinct non-null customers who ordered in each respective period. July–December had more, by 1,466 repeat customers.
